# Parameter sensitivity

*Auto-generated by `workflow/rules/sensitivity.smk`. Regenerated on every run, so it cannot drift from the tables it summarises.*

## Why this exists

Every headline number in this study depends on a threshold that was chosen rather than measured. This analysis re-runs the affected chain across a grid of alternatives, writing to a parallel tree, and reports which numbers move.

**A number that does not move across a reasonable grid is a property of the data. A number that moves is a property of a threshold.** Both are reportable; presenting them the same way is not.

| classification | meaning | how to report |
|---|---|---|
| **INVARIANT** | one value across the whole grid | report as a plain number |
| stable | spread within 15% | report the value, note the range in methods |
| **SENSITIVE** | wider | **report the value WITH its range** |

**Sensitive here:** conserved core (bound + DE in both serotypes), conserved cistrome (bound in both serotypes), A909 direct regulon, CJB111 direct regulon, A909 bound but not differentially expressed. Report each with its range and include the grid as a supplementary table.

## Reproduce

```bash
snakemake --sdm conda -c8 sensitivity_cheap      # seconds
snakemake --sdm conda -c8 sensitivity_moderate   # minutes  (FIMO threshold)
snakemake --sdm conda -c8 sensitivity_motif      # hours    (MEME width/model)
snakemake --sdm conda -c8 sensitivity_peaks      # many hours (ChExMix grid)
```

`config/config.yaml` is never modified: every combination writes to `results/11_sensitivity/<axis>/<combo>/`, and the production files are read but never overwritten.
